# WEDthread

> WEDthread is a wedding planning platform for couples. It brings the guest list, RSVPs, seating chart, budget, registry and wedding website into one plan, and includes a directory of wedding venues and vendors. It is built for weddings of every size, culture and style, including destination weddings and weddings with several events.

## What couples can do
- Guest list and RSVP tracking, with per-event invitations and WhatsApp or email messages: https://www.wedthread.co/features/guest-list
- Budget planning, expense tracking and payment reminders: https://www.wedthread.co/features/budgeting
- Seating chart maker with drag and drop tables: https://www.wedthread.co/features/seating
- Online RSVP by WhatsApp and email: https://www.wedthread.co/features/rsvp-automation
- Wedding registry from any store, plus cash funds: https://www.wedthread.co/features/registry
- Free wedding website builder: https://www.wedthread.co/features/website

## Directories
- Wedding venues by city, capacity, price and type of space: https://www.wedthread.co/venue
- Wedding vendors by category, location and budget: https://www.wedthread.co/v

## Blog
- Top 10 things to sort for your wedding, in order of priority: https://www.wedthread.co/blog/wedding-planning-priorities
- Wedding budget planning, step by step: https://www.wedthread.co/blog/wedding-budget-planning
- Unique wedding ideas for 2026 and 2027: https://www.wedthread.co/blog/unique-wedding-ideas
